brief:
Raid Abu Badayyah, a professor of international law at the Arab American University, warned that continuing Israeli breaches of the Gaza ceasefire agreement risk eroding Trump's peace plan, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Badayyah expressed concern that the Peace Council's inability to enforce compliance compounds the threat to the diplomatic initiative.

The professor's warning reflects Palestinian concerns that violations of ceasefire terms could undermine broader efforts to resolve the Israeli-Palestinian conflict through the Trump administration's proposed framework.

title: Israeli violations threaten Trump peace plan, Palestinian legal scholar warns
